note: Set B's claims are consistently bound to the right component and property (generator inertia about the high-speed shaft, drive-shaft torsional spring/damping constants, fully-deployed brake torque, brake time constant) with verbatim supporting quotes and the free-free-mode damping condition preserved. Set A repeatedly misbinds the drive-shaft spring constant to the high-speed shaft, calls the generator efficiency a drivetrain efficiency, and includes an invented 37,000 N·m/rad stiffness plus truncated values (867, 2) and fabricated/garbled quotes. Set A does capture the DOWEC 5,025,500 kg·m² inertia and the 5% damping ratio that B partly covers, but its many errors outweigh that extra coverage, while B's main weakness is redundancy and omission of the DOWEC inertia and power-loss figures.
